items.title: overall silhouette and proportions
items.note: Relative placement of enclosure, bay, conveyor and guard follows the photos; overall proportions are ESTIMATED because no wide exterior photo exists (NV-011).

items.title: main enclosure placement
items.note: Wet-cell enclosure, window face and upper head placed per PHOTO-03/04 (through-window views); size ESTIMATED.

items.title: upper assembly and cylindrical components
items.note: Two gold anodised cylinders with rods and caps plus central servo motor, as visible through the access window.

items.title: guarding, wire mesh, orange/yellow components

items.title: pipes, hoses, cables, brackets, fasteners
items.note: Green/red overhead hoses, blue pneumatic hoses, quench feed hose, cable tray, instanced bolts, valve cartridges and air elbows.
